title: Estimating the Hüsler--Reiss variogram matrix by clipped moments
summary: In multivariate extreme value analysis, the tail dependence between some of the risk variables at hand may be weak, even when other variables do tend to become large simultaneously. Weak tail dependence may induce a substantial bias in estimation procedures based on the limiting multivariate (generalized) Pareto distribution of excesses over high thresholds.
